yarn.blurb: Type something worth remembering and keep it. Ctrl+K finds it whether this tab is open or the plugin is off; a keep on the History tab has Put back while the thread is still here.
yarn.description: Keeps a list of threads and writes each keep to the journal: store, search on or off, put back.
yarn.journal.blurb: What this plugin wrote to the shared store, newest first. The History tab shows the same lines beside every other plugin's.
yarn.title: Yarn
yarn.undo.gone: That thread is not on the list any more.
